title: SPARC Cat - Sham Control Chronic Implant Cat 4, Day 14
author: Brett Hanzlicek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfzrjp56
materials: Transport cat from housing site to surgery site.

steps.title: Prepare Animal for Surgery
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the cat, shave the abdomen, and move the animal to the surgery room for monitoring.

substeps.instruction: Perform a betadine scrub on the abdomen and genitals

steps.title: Insert Bladder Catheter
steps.instruction: Insert a 3.5Fr catheter into the bladder via the urethra using surgilube.

substeps.instruction: Advance the catheter until resistance is met

steps.title: Collect Urine Sample
steps.instruction: Use a syringe with gentle suction to withdraw urine from the bladder through the catheter.

substeps.instruction: Measure the volume of urine removed (e.g., 5 mL)

steps.title: Perform Bladder CT Imaging
steps.instruction: Visualize the bladder using a 1:5 dilution of contrast to saline.

substeps.instruction: Fill the bladder with 15 mL of the contrast/saline mixture

steps.title: Set Up Urodynamics Recording
steps.instruction: Transfer the cat from isoflurane to propofol anesthetic and configure the pressure recording system.

substeps.instruction: Connect an external pressure transducer to a syringe pump on one end and tubing leading to the catheter on the other
Set up data recording using Labview software
Set the syringe pump fill rate to 2 mL saline/minute

steps.title: Perform Urodynamic Pressure Recording
steps.instruction: Fill the bladder with saline at 2 mL/min and record the pressure using the pressure transducer and LabView.

substeps.instruction: Continue filling until the leak point is detected (leakage around the catheter)
Note the volume of saline added at the leak point
Observe and record any spontaneous contractions occurring without pulling on the catheter
Remove the total volume of saline and urine from the bladder

steps.title: Post-Procedure Recovery
steps.instruction: Wait for the cat to wake up and return the animal to its housing site.
